Description of the property

Leuven: Semi-detached house with modern look and spacious front garden
In a convenient location in Leuven, close to all amenities, you will find this semi-detached house. With its modern white façade finish and triple glazing, the property combines contemporary comfort with a practical layout.
The house offers generous living spaces and a large front garden. It is the ideal home for anyone looking to live comfortably in a green environment without compromising on accessibility.
Layout:
Entrance hall, kitchen, living room, dining room, laundry room, bathroom, veranda, and garden. Basement included.
Upstairs: night hall, two bedrooms, and an additional bathroom.
Assets:

  • Modern design with white plaster and triple glazing
  • Spacious front garden
  • Practical layout with two bathrooms
  • Quiet location with excellent accessibility

More information? Contact ERA Vandendries at +3216895050 or info@vastgoedvandendries.be
